rules_shown.rule: When an object must be picked up and placed: search surfaces first, then containers, take the object, go to the target, open the target if closed, move the object to the target.
rules_shown.example: search armchair 1, drawer 1, take watch 1, go to coffeetable 1, move watch 1 to coffeetable 1
rules_shown.validation: This game confirmed opening the target container before moving the object is required. | This game confirmed searching bed 1 (surface) works for pickup and direct move to desk works for placement. | This game confirmed searching drawers (containers) is necessary when the object is not on surfaces.
rules_shown.rendered_for_agent: [Success Process] When an object must be picked up and placed: search surfaces first, then containers, take the object, go to the target, open the target if closed, move the object to the target. Example: search armchair 1, drawer 1, take watch 1, go to coffeetable 1, move watch 1 to coffeetable 1

rules_shown.rule: When placing an object into a container, open the container if closed before attempting the move.
rules_shown.example: open cabinet 1 before moving handtowel 1 to cabinet 1
rules_shown.validation: This game confirmed failing to move while the container was closed, succeeding only after opening it.
rules_shown.rendered_for_agent: [Corrected Error] When placing an object into a container, open the container if closed before attempting the move. Example: open cabinet 1 before moving handtowel 1 to cabinet 1

rules_shown.rule: When placing an object on a target, use 'move <object> to <target>' after taking it, not 'go to <target>' then 'take' again.
rules_shown.example: take cellphone from armchair, go to bed, move cellphone to bed
rules_shown.rendered_for_agent: [Corrected Error] When placing an object on a target, use 'move <object> to <target>' after taking it, not 'go to <target>' then 'take' again. Example: take cellphone from armchair, go to bed, move cellphone to bed
